data.gender_notes: Faseelah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘faslah’, meaning ‘to free’, ‘to deliver’, or ‘to protect’. This name symbolizes a protector, a shield, and one who delivers and frees. The name Faseelah carries the meaning “Protector, shield” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Faseelah usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, shield and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of protection and deliverance in Islamic spiritual tradition.
data.etymology: Faseelah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector, shield.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faseelah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

The name often symbolizes a strong protector, a characteristic that was highly valued in Islamic society, where community and protection of the faith were paramount.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Faseelah signifies a shield or protector from the trials and tribulations of life. It is a reminder that Allah, the Almighty, is our ultimate Protector and Shield. The name also symbolizes liberation, a deliverance from suffering and hardship, and a spiritual freedom that comes from inner peace, patience, and faith. Just as a shield protects the body, the name Faseelah reminds us to protect ourselves spiritually and to seek Allah’s guidance and protection always.
